purpose: Run manifest-partitioned work as Slurm job arrays or HTCondor clusters with duplicate-safe collection, bounded explicit resubmission and provenance
environment: HTCondor: lxplus (AlmaLinux 9, x86_64), CERN local pool, HTCondor 24.12.16 client and schedd (bigbird13), campaign on AFS, workers EL9 with /usr/bin/python3 3.9.25 as worker_python, adapter driven by Python 3.11; two synthetic 5-chunk campaigns (shared-filesystem and transfer modes) merged equal to a local single run on 2026-10-10 (T03 H4), and RealHTCondorTests with HEP_HTCONDOR_TEST=1 and HEP_HTCONDOR_CONFIG. Slurm: no real Slurm has run this backend (no environment to declare); tests run both backends against fake schedulers (tests/adapters/batch_shims) in E1 (Python 3.11.15, standard library); real-tool tests need HEP_SLURM_TEST=1 / HEP_HTCONDOR_TEST=1
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; each tool's own status is in tools[]; fake-scheduler tests never raise a tool above documented
